merge_basis: Candidate T0016 covers Zongertinib in Gastric Cancer 2L (Beamion Gastric-1, 1479-0013), a distinct indication and study from all existing groups: G0003 is 1L NSCLC NDA approval, G0011 is an IIS NSCLC China study, and G0012 is Breast Cancer 2L (Beamion Breast-2, 1479-0017). Different indication, different study number, and different clinical context — no match.
